regime.summary: SBP held at 11.5% on 2026-09-14, but the 6M bill cutoff of 12.40% sits 0.90pp above policy, so the market prices hikes. CPI is falling (10.3% from 11.08%). Brent is up 51% in three months, and KMI is down 4.2% over 3 months. Mixed tide, so neutral; a hike would be the risk, a CPI run lower the opportunity.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.5%; last MPC decision 2026-09-14: hold (+0bp)
Regime: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.90pp (market pricing hikes); CPI falling over 3 months (-0.8pp)

core.thesis: Refiner with EPS up 202% year on year at a P/E of 8.1, at its 252-day high; the refinery policy was approved by the Cabinet Committee on Energy. Growth is visible, but price is extended, so the stop is the business, not the chart.

evidence.quote: approved the revamped refinery policy on 28 Jul 2026

core.thesis: E&P with EPS up 97% year on year, 13.5% below its high, with Brent at 126. Growing, not merely stable, and the price has not moved with it (3m -0.6%).

evidence.quote: B13. Is it growing, not merely stable?

core.thesis: Diversified builder with EPS up 29% at a P/E of 6.8, 21% below its high. Material information was filed on 2026-10-07; business intact, and a falling price alone is not a reason to leave.

watch.subject: Next SBP MPC
watch.trigger: If the 6M bill cutoff falls back toward 11.5% or CPI keeps falling, raise exposure toward 90% by adding to the core. If the SBP hikes, cut the weakest core name and hold cash.

watch.subject: ASL
watch.trigger: Convert to an order only if a sponsor or insider buy is filed and public (n_insider_buy above 0) while price is within 5% of the 15.09 close; EPS is up 43x, price 15% below its high.

watch.subject: PRL and NRL (refiners at 252-day highs)
watch.trigger: Convert only after a 10% pullback that holds on closes with results published; today both are extended after 3m gains of 140% and 68%.

entries.reason: EPS up 215% year on year at a P/E of 5.6 with price down 4% over 3 months and 12.6% below its high, while Brent is up 51%. Base rate for P/E below 6 at 120 sessions is 61% hit, not confirmed, so size is modest. Loss if stopped is about 1% of the book.

exposure_reason: Slightly under the 75% default: the market prices hikes (6M bill 0.90pp over policy) and KMI is down 4.2% in 3 months, so I keep 30% in cash for a post-MPC add. Not lower, since CPI is falling and no measured timing signal exists to justify sitting out.
not_known: Reserves and current account are not in the pack. IMF status, the next MPC date, and the nine-month results for the core names are unknown. Oil concentration across ATRL, MARI and OGDC is a shared bet on Brent.
contamination_note: No memory of events after 2026-10-16 was used. Base-rate rows were used only as rough odds for a type.
